title: Work ledger proposal v3
description: One thing the owner wants, from the words as captured (raw) to the plan it became (planned). Replaces v2 ideas and proposals. The paired Markdown holds the immutable original thought and the editable proposal body; this file holds lifecycle and links.

status.description: raw: the words only. draft/ready: being elaborated. accepted: agreed, no roadmap yet. planned: at least one roadmap is open. parked: kept, not now. archived: every roadmap closed, or retired. declined: decided against. archived and declined bundles live under archive/proposals/.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown on the card.

source.description: Where the words came from: chat, voice, telegram, migration…

formerly.description: Ids this proposal had before (v2 ideas and proposals), so old references still resolve.
